title: L’ambre : texte à trous
subtitle: Complétez avec le nom, le verbe ou l’adjectif qui manque
label: Cloze test
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the French and the answers before using it with learners.
intro: The words come from the text, used in new sentences. Accents are not required to be marked right.

items.tr: The stars shine in the sky.
I thought it was a joke.
Put a drop of honey in your tea.
My parents let me go out on Saturday evenings.
He is wearing a thick coat.
This book, damaged by damp, is unreadable.
The water flows from the tap.
The chicken is nicely golden: it's cooked.
In this film, strange creatures live under the sea.
My son wants to become a doctor.
